title: Faded paint on park entrance sign
description: The wooden sign at the entrance of Sector 5 park has slightly faded green paint.

title: Slightly misaligned trash bin cover
description: The metal lid of the public trash bin near bus stop 4 is slightly bent and resting at an angle.
notes: No safety hazard or waste spill.

title: Faded directional arrow on quiet side street
description: The white directional arrow painted on the tarmac of Lane 3 is partially worn off.
notes: Minor aesthetic wear on low traffic lane.

title: Small poster sticker on streetlight pole
description: An unauthorized paper advertisement sticker is glued to the base of streetlight pole 12.

title: Overflowing garbage dump in market alley
description: Multiple trash bags have accumulated near the vegetable market and are starting to spill over.

title: Low water pressure in Sector 12 residential block
description: Residents on the second floor are experiencing weak water pressure during peak morning hours.

title: Broken wooden bench in community garden
description: One of the wooden slats on the park bench near the fountain has cracked and needs replacement.

title: Overgrown tree branches touching telephone wires
description: Branch from an oak tree is leaning heavily on overhead telephone cables along 8th Avenue.

title: Deep hazardous pothole on busy double lane road
description: A 3-foot wide deep pothole has formed near the highway turn causing cars to swerve suddenly.

title: Dark unlit street due to multiple broken streetlights
description: Four consecutive streetlight poles on 4th Main road are completely burnt out creating a dark corridor.

title: Blocked storm sewer grate causing water pooling
description: Debris and plastic waste have completely clogged the rainwater drain grate on Commercial Street.

title: Foul chemical odor emitting from open industrial drain
description: Strong pungent chemical smell causing nausea for nearby shop owners along Factory Road.

title: Sparking exposed high-voltage cable outside school gate
description: A heavy electrical cable has snapped and is dangling near St. Jude school gate with visible sparks.

title: Burst chemical pipe discharging toxic sludge into canal
description: Industrial pipe rupture is discharging dark foul-smelling chemical sludge directly into the drinking water canal.

title: Missing manhole cover on unlit pedestrian footpath
description: Open 4-foot deep sewer manhole with no warning barrier on dark walkway near Metro Station.

title: Collapsing brick wall leaning over busy sidewalk
description: Structural retaining wall has cracked severely and is bowing outward onto the main pedestrian sidewalk.
